h2: NDT services in Tampa: what gets inspected around the bay, and where guided wave fits
html:
NDT services in Tampa: what gets inspected around the bay, and where guided wave fits

The port drives most NDT work in Tampa. Its main assets are fuel terminals and transfer lines, ship repair yards, a repowered gas-fired power station and a phosphate fertilizer plant. Guided wave covers one part of that work: screening long runs of piping that cannot be reached along their length. Atlantis works from Houston and mobilizes crews job by job, with each procedure checked by an ASNT NDT Level III.

The asset base around the bay.

  • Fuel import terminals. According to Argus, nearly half of Florida's petroleum supply comes through Port Tampa Bay, mostly by water from the US Gulf Coast. Terminal operators on the bay include Citgo, Chevron, Buckeye, Global Partners and Kinder Morgan.
  • Pipelines inland and offshore. The Central Florida Pipeline collects product from five Port Tampa Bay area terminals and delivers it to Orlando. Its 85-mile, 10-inch line is the sole pipeline supply of jet fuel to Orlando International Airport. The Gulfstream natural gas pipeline crosses the Gulf and comes ashore at Port Manatee.
  • Ship repair. Tampa Ship at Hookers Point, Gulf Marine Repair on the Ybor Channel and Hendry Corporation at Port Hendry dock and repair tugs, barges and offshore vessels.
  • Power. Big Bend, Tampa Electric's gas-fired station at Apollo Beach, has run in combined cycle since 2023.
  • Fertilizer. Mosaic's Riverview plant produces about 18 percent of the phosphate fertilizer used in North America, and Mosaic also has bulk handling operations at Port Tampa Bay.

Where guided wave screening is used. Guided wave suits pipe that can be reached at one point but not along its length. Examples are product lines under roads and rail inside terminal fences, sleeved crossings, dock lines on pipe racks, and insulated runs. A transducer collar fitted at one spot tests a length of line in both directions. The result tells the owner which sections need detailed examination. In a humid coastal climate with salt in the air, corrosion under insulation and at pipe supports is the usual target. Results are poorer on lines with heavy wrap coatings, many bends or a lot of branch connections, so the survey plan should mark which runs are worth screening.

What follows the screening. Guided wave does not give a wall thickness. Every section it flags needs a sizing method before the owner decides on a repair:

  • automated UT corrosion mapping once the coating or insulation is removed;
  • pulsed eddy current through the insulation where stripping it is not practical;
  • conventional UT, radiography of small-bore lines and visual examination of supports.

Atlantis supplies these methods for piping programs run under API 570. The owner's API 570 inspector sets the intervals.

Storm season and restarts. Kinder Morgan shut its Tampa terminals and the Central Florida Pipeline ahead of Hurricane Milton in October 2024, only days after the pipeline had restarted following Helene. A restart after a storm surge is a good time to check the following, and to bring forward any screening that was already due:

  • exposed jetty and rack piping;
  • pipe supports;
  • insulation that took on seawater.

Next steps. NDT inspection services lists every method Atlantis offers. Corrosion under insulation inspection covers programs for insulated lines. For Tampa-specific scopes, see piping inspection in Tampa and pipeline inspection in Tampa. Describe the Tampa line or asset with the line list, insulation details and access, and the scope and quote are prepared from that.
